description: odo-optional's table with an alternation inside it, and variant-sliding's alternation at the one declared maximum where a table can be mistaken for an ordinary group: OCCURS 0 TO 1 TIMES DEPENDING ON, read odoslide, with a REDEFINES inside the group. Four records -- no note, a note taking the text arm, a note taking the code arm, and no note again -- so the group's absence is met twice and both arms are met once. What the entry is here to catch is a consumer that asks whether an item repeats by reading the copybook's declared maximum alone: at a maximum of one that answer is no, so the group is read unconditionally and, worse, the REDEFINES inside it is not inside a table at all -- which makes the alternation two descriptions of the whole record rather than two arms of one occurrence, and leaves the consumer with no arm to take. The coded entry is two bytes shorter than the run it redefines, so its slack travels with the occurrence it was read from and is put back where it was found; VOP-TAIL is what turns any of this into a visible error, because on the two records whose count is zero a consumer that read the group anyway runs off the end of a five-byte record rather than returning a wrong value.
